prompt: For each Voltmarkt store, how many orders were placed from 3 to 9 March 2025 (the UTC days of order_ts), and how many units did they hold? Count only the orders that have at least one order line: an order with no lines is left out of both counts. Return exactly three columns, in this order: store_code, orders and units. Return one row for each store with orders in those days. Any row order is fine.

output_contract.grain: one row per store with orders from 3 to 9 March 2025

hints: Next, write the filter that keeps only the lines of that week's orders, before they are added up.
The lines carry no date: keep the lines whose order_id belongs to an order placed in those days.
faded_shape:
WITH order_units AS (
  -- one row per order placed from 3 to 9 March 2025 (UTC days of order_ts): its units, added up before any join
  SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS units
  FROM order_lines
why_this_works: The lines are filtered and added up to one row per order before the join, so COUNT(*) counts orders and the join adds no rows.
faded_suffix:
GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(u.units) AS units
FROM order_units u
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = u.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_code
